Cristiano Ronaldo and Georgina Rodriguez marry in Portugal

Footballer Cristiano Ronaldo and his long-time partner Georgina Rodriguez have married in a private civil ceremony in Cascais, Portugal, on August 11. The couple, who have been together for nearly a decade and have five children, confirmed the marriage with a joint Instagram post showing their wedding rings. Some reports indicated that 2,000 fans mistakenly went to a church due to a wedding rumour.
